{{Quote|The Jedi are guardians of peace and justice. We are servants, not celebrities.|Coleman Trebor|<ref name="hnn1">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|jediwatch/1337_1.html|Jedi Refuse to Hand Over Baby Ludi}}</ref>}}
'''Coleman Trebor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Vurk/Legends|Vurk]] from [[Sembla/Legends|Sembla]], who served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Council]] member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Trebor was one of few Vurks to earn [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] fame some time before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], after averting a number of [[Planet/Legends|interplanetary]] disputes without bloodshed. Something of a celebrity with [[HoloNet News/Legends|the media]], Trebor was well-connected, with numerous diverse contacts located throughout the galaxy.

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], after the [[Skirmish at Coruscant's power core|death]] of [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]], Trebor was chosen for a place on the Jedi High Council, and he participated in many missions during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]; along with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], he foiled an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], and participated in the [[Battle of Antar 4 (Separatist Crisis)|Battle of Antar 4]] over a year later.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Trebor traveled to the world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] along with a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] of two hundred Jedi to rescue [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from the clutches of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Trebor participated in the skirmish in the [[Petranaki arena]], using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to slay many [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] and destroy many Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. When he realized an opportunity to kill Dooku, he leapt onto [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] viewing box, taking the Count by surprise. However, Dooku's right-hand-man, [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], fired upon Trebor with his [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], sending him to his death as he fell many meters.

It was later said that, had Trebor been successful, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] might have been averted.

==Biography==
===Jedi Master===
[[File:Coleman_Trebor.png|thumb|left|225px|Jedi Master Coleman Trebor.]]
Coleman Trebor was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Vurk/Legends|Vurk]] native to the backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sembla/Legends|Sembla]], born during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Though Trebor's species was considered primitive by [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] standards, he was found to be [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] early in his life, and was taken in by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for training. He became a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and eventually a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]],<ref name="db" /> the only known Vurk to have done so.<ref name="negas">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> As a Master, he peacefully resolved a number of large disputes between important planets with great success, earning a reputation as a skilled negotiator and diplomat. Like all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Trebor was trained in the art of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], though he preferred to use words over violence. Despite this, he never hesitated to draw his weapon when the situation required it of him, and he was known to be a cunning warrior.<ref name="ff">{{FactFile|106|TRE 1-2|Coleman Trebor}}</ref> Trebor also spent time in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="egttf">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> He shared a close friendship with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] female [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Jyl Somtay]], and the two had many insightful conversations.<ref name="Death in the Catacombs">{{InsiderCite|79|Death in the Catacombs}}</ref>

Trebor made many contacts while serving as a mediator, and was well-known throughout the galaxy, as well as in the Jedi Order. Many outsiders of the Order believed that he represented how they expected a Jedi to behave,<ref name="ff" /> and he was widely respected,<ref name="who's who">{{InsiderCite|62|Who's Who in the Jedi Order}}</ref> which was something of a surprise to many considering his humble background.<ref name="ff" /> After Jedi Master [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Trebor was appointed as his replacement on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The Council chose him because of his myriad contacts around the galaxy, and because of his abilities in dealing with other species. He was often sent to social events to act as a representative of the Council,<ref name="ff" /> and was a spokesbeing for the Jedi Order, often directly speaking to the media.<ref name="hnn1" />

In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], a terrorist named [[Granta Omega]] stormed the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] with a group of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] in an attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Coleman Trebor and fellow Jedi [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] were among the first to learn of the attack and they traveled to the Senate Building post haste, along with teams of Jedi. Palpatine was located in the unoccupied [[Grand Convocation Chamber]], and Trebor and his fellow Jedi used the pods in which [[Senator/Legends|senators]] normally sat to propel themselves forward, toward Omega and Palpatine. They engaged many of the assassin droids, destroying them. Ultimately, Omega's plot was foiled and Palpatine emerged unscathed.<ref name="False Peace">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>

[[File:Jedicouncil2.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Jedi Master Coleman Trebor on the Jedi Council]]
Trebor joined the Council during a turbulent period, known as the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]; former Jedi Master [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had founded the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and many [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] were seceding from the Republic and joining the Separatists. In [[23 BBY/Legends|22.5 BBY]], a Separatist sect dubbed the [[Roshu Sune/Legends|Roshu Sune]] emerged on [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]], the home [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] species, and uncover agents working for the Roshu Sune infiltrated many chapter houses of the Jedi-allied [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]]. Overnight, many Rangers were killed and Antar 4 was thrown into disarray. Eager for revenge, Antarian Rangers from across the galaxy converged on the moon, while Coleman Trebor and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] led battalion of Jedi Knights to deal with the threat posed by the Roshu Sune.<ref name="nec" />

The first assault was a disaster, resulting in monumental loss of life on both sides. For the second assault, Trebor and Tiin used electromagnetic pulses to overwhelm the Gotals' sensitive headcones, and were able to apprehend and defeat the Roshu Sune without bloodshed. However, the attack upset the majority of the local populace, who believed the Jedi had used sloppy tactics. Trebor and Tiin returned to Coruscant, but the damage had been done; the public image of the Jedi had been damaged, and many looked to the [[Battle of Antar 4 (Separatist Crisis)|Battle of Antar 4]] as a reason for seceding. The remaining members of the Roshu Sune carried out many terrorist acts on Coruscant in Dooku's name, which the leader of the CIS never publicly condemned. The Jedi Council, convinced that Dooku, a former Jedi, was nothing more than a peaceful political idealist, refused to make the link between the attacks and Dooku.<ref name="nec" />

===Final mission===
[[File:TreborConfrontsDooku-AOTC.png|thumb|200px|Trebor encounters [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] seconds before his death.]]
[[File:Deathofcoleman.jpg|thumb|200px|Trebor's death.]]
Like many of his peers from the High Council, Master Trebor was part of the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi task force]] sent to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|rescue]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Several minutes into the battle, he attempted to attack [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] alone, even though the Count was said to possess vastly superior lightsaber skills. It would not come to a duel, however&mdash;Trebor was shot at by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], who was standing at Dooku's side, but he deflected the first two shots. The third shot was aimed at his shoulder, hitting it successfully, and the last shot hit him in the abdomen. The force of blow lifted him clean off his feet over the balcony, causing him to fall to his death.<ref name="aotc" />

===Legacy===
The conflict after the battle on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] became the galaxy-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and it was later mused that the Clone Wars may have been averted had Trebor struck Dooku down.

==Personality and traits==
[[File:ColemanTrebor-TLC.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Jedi Master Coleman Trebor]]
Coleman Trebor considered himself to be more of a diplomat than a fighter, and was known for peacefully settling a number of interplanetary disputes. Though he was well known for his diplomacy skills, as well as being very humble, he believed that Jedi were servants, not celebrities. He was also insightful and shared a close friendship with a Padawan named [[Jyl Somtay]]. Despite his peaceful personality, Master Trebor was courageous enough to attempt to attack Count Dooku, but his attempt was foiled by Jango Fett.<ref name="aotc" />

==Skills and abilities==
Although noted more for his considerable diplomatic abilities, Trebor was a deadly lightsaber combatant.<ref name="ff" /> One of the greatest Jedi of the Old Republic,<ref name="who's who" /> Trebor was capable of besting most adversaries with or without his lightsaber.<ref name="ff" />

As a Jedi Master, Trebor's knowledge of the Force was almost unparalleled. He was highly skilled in the ability of Force Stealth, which he used to successfully sneak up on Count Dooku.<ref name="ff" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coleman Trebor was realized as a completely computer-generated character by [[Industrial Light & Magic]], making appearances in both the Jedi Temple and at the Battle of Geonosis during [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']]. His headcrest and other features were modeled after the fossil remains of the famous hadrosaurid ''Parasaurolophus''.<ref name="db" />

Trebor is used as a model for the [https://www.rebelscum.com/SWminiMOTF03Jediinstructor.asp Jedi Instructor] miniature from the [[Star Wars Miniatures]] set, [[Masters of the Force (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Masters of the Force'']]. Curiously, instead of being a part of the baseline Republic faction, he is part of the Old Republic faction. In 2013, Coleman Trebor appears in the Lego Star Wars 75019 AT-TE set.
